NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Code of Conduct and Ethics
 Document ID
NT-LEG-006
Department
Legal and Compliance
Version
5.0
Effective Date
01 January 2025
1. Our Values
NovaTech's four core values are Integrity, Customer Focus, Ownership and Respect. Every
employee is expected to follow these values in all dealings with colleagues, customers and
partners.
2. Anti-Harassment
NovaTech has zero tolerance for harassment, discrimination or bullying. Complaints of sexual
harassment are handled by the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC). The ICC must complete its
inquiry within 90 days of receiving a complaint. Retaliation against anyone who files a complaint in
good faith is strictly prohibited.
3. Conflict of Interest
Employees must disclose any situation where personal interests may conflict with the company's
interests. Employees may not work for a competitor or take a second job without written approval
from the HR Director. Disclosure must be made through the Compliance Portal within 15 days of
the conflict arising.
4. Gifts and Hospitality
Employees may accept gifts from vendors or clients only if the value is below Rs. 2,000. Any gift
worth Rs. 2,000 or more must be declined or reported to the Compliance team within 7 days. Cash
gifts and gift cards must never be accepted.
5. Whistleblower Protection
Employees can report unethical behaviour confidentially through the Ethics Hotline at
ethics@novatech.example or by calling 1800-000-0000, available 24 hours a day. Reports can be
made anonymously. The Ethics Committee reviews every report and responds within 10 working
days.
6. Consequences of Violations
Violations of this code may lead to disciplinary action ranging from a written warning to termination
of employment, depending on how serious the violation is.
Document Notice
Confidentiality Notice: This document is the property of NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and is
intended for internal use by employees only. Unauthorised copying, sharing or distribution outside
the company is prohibited. For clarifications, contact the People and Culture team at
hr@novatech.example.
